summary: A compact visual indicator used to label, categorise, or show the status of an item.
useWhen: Showing a short category, attribute, or status label.
Representing a selection that the user may remove.
avoidWhen: The element's primary purpose is to perform an action; use a Button instead.
Showing a numeric count; use Badge when a count is the important information.

alternatives.when: The user needs to trigger an action rather than inspect or remove a label.

pitfalls: Use ariaLabelOfRemoveButton when the translated default removal label is not suitable for the surrounding context.
Use inverse on dark backgrounds to preserve contrast.
Keep labels concise; use wrapText with maxWidth only when wrapping cannot be avoided.

examples.description: Allow an unusually long label to wrap within a constrained width.
Make a pill removable by providing onDelete, and customise its accessible label when needed.
Use inverse styling when pills appear on a dark surface.
